week19_dev: Skin ra prais kum takan sa.
week20_dev: Pyua tara baila. Tuktan li amniotik disa.

week39_dev: Tuktan sut ridi sa bara takaia sip sa.

week4_tips: Prueba de embaraso munaia sip sma pyua luisa kaka.

week6_tips: Daktar kaikaia pas tara ba aitani munaia.
week7_tips: Aimakaia yamni. Wan tikaia ba natkira sa.
week9_tips: Li ailal tikaia bara wahya nani piaia.
week10_tips: Yutka ba arangs baku tara sa.
week11_tips: Plun sat walka bri kaia ba natkira sa.
week12_tips: Ultrasonido pas tara. Kati yauhka pas tara tnata alkaia.
week13_tips: Byara saura kau mayara taki aulisa.
week14_tips: Kati yauhka wal. Mairin ailal kau karna lukisa.
week15_tips: Yapaia left sayt ra, kau yamni left sayt ra.
week16_tips: Daktar kaikaia: pura tara bara prais lukaia.
week17_tips: Kwala bukika dimi bas. Byara taki aulisa.
week19_tips: Plun ayanka brisa piaia: bins, ki, wina.
week20_tips: Baila ra sma. Naha pyua yamni kulkaia.
week23_tips: Daktar kaikaia kati bani MINSA tanka kat.

week28_tips: Kati yauhka yuhmpa. Tuktan munan kulkaia yua bani.
week29_tips: Daktar kaikaia wik wal bani nanara.
week30_tips: Bag ridi munaia haspital ra waia.
week31_tips: Aimakaia bara mina nani purara mangkaia puhban bri kaka.
week32_tips: Helk sentru kau lamara ba kaikaia.
week34_tips: Daktar kaikaia: tuktan nahki dingki ba.
week35_tips: Transpurte plan ridi bri kaia haspital ra waia.
week37_tips: Tuktan ani pyua ra sip sa takaia. Ridi bas.
week39_tips: Bag bara plan pali ridi ba kaikaia.
week40_tips: Tuktan takaia yua. Sainkam apu kaka daktar kaikaia.

faq_cycle_what_is: Dia sa mairin ai pyua ba?
faq_cycle_what_is_content: Mairin ai pyua ba wina tanka kum yua 21 wina 35 kat brisa. 4 sat brisa: talya yua, raya takan, kyamka takaia, bara kyamka aimakan. Kati bani wantma ridi takisa tuktan briaia.
faq_cycle_irregular: Natkira sa yang pyuaki sat walka ba?
faq_cycle_irregular_content: Natkira sa pyua nani sat walka kaia. Pyuam ailal sat walka kaka 35 yua pura luisa kaka, helk sentru ra waia.
faq_cycle_pain: Pyua ra saura lukaia ba natkira sa?
faq_cycle_pain_content: Saura sirpi kaka natkira sa. Saura pali kaka bara wark munaia sip apu kaka, helk sentru ra waia.
faq_cycle_fertile: Nahki kaiki sna tuktan briaia sip sna ba?
faq_cycle_fertile_content: Tuktan briaia sip takan pyua ba yua 10 wina 17 kat brisa pyua 28 yua kat ra. Metztli man dukyam kulkisa.
faq_pregnancy_signs: Dia nani ba pyua tara pas tara sainka?
faq_pregnancy_signs_content: Pas tara sainka nani ba: pyua luisa, byara saura tisku ra, tyuty saura, wan tikaia bara smel sat walka. Prueba de embaraso wal kasak tanka brisa.
faq_pregnancy_prenatal: Dia muni daktar kaikaia ba tara sa?
faq_pregnancy_prenatal_content: Daktar kaikaia ba pyua tara trabil nani pas ra kaikaia sip sa. MINSA tanka kat 4 baku daktar kaikaia pyua tara ra.
faq_pregnancy_danger: Dia nani ba saura tanka pyua tara ra?
faq_pregnancy_danger_content: Halp pliki bas: talya taki aula, byara saura pali, nakra dimi tanka apu, mawan mihta puhban, rih tara, tuktan kau munas.
faq_pregnancy_nutrition: Dia piaia sna pyua tara ra?
faq_pregnancy_nutrition_content: Plun sat ailal piaia: bins, raiz, ki, wina, inska, wahya nani. Li ailal tikaia, tyuya sip kaka, bara alkhol apia.
faq_pregnancy_kicks: Nahki tuktan munan nani kulki sna?
faq_pregnancy_kicks_content: Wik 28 wina, sayt ra iwaia bara munan nani kulkaia. 10 munan 2 aurs ra briaia sa. Kau mayara kaka daktar kaikaia.
faq_menopause_what_is_content: Menopausia ba pyua sut takaskaia sa, mani 45 wina 55 kat. Wina tanka natkira kum sa.
faq_menopause_hotflash_content: Bochorno nani ba lapta tara kum ai pali taki aulisa minit nani kat. Menopausia ra ailal taki aulisa bara pyua ra kau yamni takisa.
faq_menopause_bones: Nahki dusaki nani main munaia sna menopausia ningkara?
faq_menopause_bones_content: Kalsium plun piaia (tyuya, kes, tastah), 30 minit impakaia yua bani, bara tisku ra wan ingnika ra vitamin D dukyara.
faq_plants_chamomile_content: Manzanilla ba aimaki tanka brisa bara byara klahkan sirpi ra yamni sa. Te baku tikaia. Pyua tara ra pas daktar makabi walaia.
faq_plants_ginger_content: Jengibre ba byara saura pyua tara ra yamni sa. Wahka sirpi piaia sip sma apia kaka te baku. Sirpi baman yus munaia.
faq_plants_cinnamon_content: Kanela ba byara klahkan pyua ra yus munisa almuk nani wal. Pyua tara ra ailal yus munaia apia sa.
